annotations.text:
Four directions for the landing page, each shown as the hero plus one inner section so you can see how it carries to the other pages.

A · Blueprint — evolves what you have: drafting grid, registration marks, dimension lines, extruded type, a mono coordinate readout. Stays inside every brand rule. Trade-off: the least dramatic change.

B · Console — the platform leads: a live-looking computation console in the hero, terminal-style status bar, products as panes. Trade-off: monospace-heavy, can read cold for advisory clients.

C · Holographic — glass panels, layered planes, teal glow and light beams. The most 'futuristic' in the mainstream sense. Trade-off: uses glow, shadow and a soft gradient, which the brand rules currently forbid.

D · Kinetic — type is the whole composition: 168px staggered headline, an outlined 'defended.', a ticker of statutory facts cutting across, one huge outlined number. Trade-off: brand statement over product; less to look at in the hero.

Pick one, or tell me which parts of two to combine, and I'll build the full landing page and the inner pages in that direction.
